title: Certified Business Development Professional
overview: This course equips participants with the essential tools and strategies required to drive business growth and secure new opportunities. Without the right skills, sales can plateau, and profitability may decline. The program delves into approaches for maximizing company profits by building relationships with key market players and decision-makers. Attendees will learn how to create and implement promotional strategies to enhance market visibility and explore cost-effective, innovative methods for increasing sales.
audience: This course is designed for sales representatives, supervisors, managers, and account managers who wish to advance their professional development by capitalizing on business opportunities to enhance management capabilities and personal branding.
methodology: The course utilizes a blend of case studies, hands-on exercises, group presentations, and self-assessment tools to develop participants into successful business development professionals.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand the core functions and best practices of Business Development (BD)
Recognize the importance of adapting business processes to align with evolving market and customer demands
Develop unique sales and marketing differentiators to stand out from competitors through value-based propositions
Design and apply financial ratios and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to assess the efficiency of operations
Lead business development efforts and key account teams using effective leadership, negotiation, and power proposals

outline.title: Business Development: Overview and Best Practices

items.text: Defining business development and its scope
The evolving landscape of account management and BD
Building an ideal client profile through client classification

Conducting customer surveys to identify service priorities
Fostering client relationships using the F.O.R.M. model
Reviewing and optimizing the selling process

Recognizing phases of the purchasing decision

outline.title: Building and Leading the Business Development Team

items.text: Stages of team formation and development
Building a high-performance business development team
Exploring industry practices of exemplary leaders
Applying formatting techniques for winning proposals
Steps for developing successful project proposals
Workshop: Drafting your own project proposal
